aggregation.rationale_sum: SUM preserves additive contribution/mass across tokens; MEAN is average per-token importance (different question).

attention.claim_language:
Attention is an internal importance proxy / baseline.
Do not describe raw attention as inherently faithful explanation.

rq1_primary.name: RQ1_FULLY_VISIBLE_2048
rq1_primary.note: Unchanged from V1; truncated commits excluded from primary RQ1.

rq234_primary.name: ALL_POSITIVE_TEST_COMMITS
rq234_primary.note:
RQ2/RQ3/RQ4 primary cohort is all 475 positive TEST commits.
Truncated commits remain eligible; evaluations use only model-visible
regions under WHOLE_SEGMENT_PREFIX_TRUNCATION_V1 (no silent partial RQ1).

faithfulness.aopc_note: Higher AOPC_deletion / AOPC_insertion indicates stronger faithfulness under the respective curve; report both; do not cherry-pick.

deletion_curve.aopc_summary:
AOPC_deletion = mean_f D(f) over primary_fractions
(equivalently average comprehensiveness at those fractions).
deletion_curve.definition:
Rank regions by method rank_score. For each fraction f in primary_fractions,
let k = max(1, ceil(f*N)). Apply PAYLOAD_BLANK_V1 to the top-k regions.
Record s_f = s(x_blanked_top_k). Deletion drop D(f) = s(x) - s_f.
deletion_curve.name: DELETION_CURVE_V1

insertion_curve.definition:
Start from fully blanked payloads (PAYLOAD_BLANK_V1 on all candidate regions),
score s_empty. For each fraction f, restore (un-blank) the top-k regions by
rank_score, k = max(1, ceil(f*N)). Record s_f_ins. Insertion gain
I(f) = s_f_ins - s_empty.
insertion_curve.name: INSERTION_CURVE_V1

ig.nonconvergence_policy:
IG_NONCONVERGED remains in other-method analyses; excluded only from analyses
requiring valid IG; counted and reported; never replaced by another method.
ig.primary_baseline_caveat:
ZERO_EMBEDDING is a canonical/reproducible baseline, NOT assumed semantically
neutral for decoder LLMs (Jacobian Scopes arXiv:2601.16407; not JIT-specific).
ig.result_policy:
Primary tables use ZERO_EMBEDDING IG unless implementation failure before results.
PAD is predeclared sensitivity. Do NOT choose the better-looking baseline post hoc.
ig.retry_policy:
If E_rel > 0.05 at 50 steps, rerun SAME example at 100 steps.
If E_rel <= 0.05 at 100, accept 100-step attribution.
Else mark IG_NONCONVERGED for that baseline/example.

perturbation_operators.rationale:
Occlusion attribution (A5) uses SEGMENT_DELETE_V1 (remove complete semantic
segment: marker+payload, then re-render). Primary RQ2 faithfulness must NOT
reuse the identical operator; PAYLOAD_BLANK_V1 blanks line/hunk payloads while
retaining structural markers / chat wrapper so Comp/Suff/AOPC are not
self-evaluating the same deletion operator used to define occlusion scores.

rq3_attention_top2_hunks.definition:
Take top-2 hunks by primary attention aggregation (SUM of line attention within hunk,
RAW_DESCENDING). For each, compute signed occlusion delta via SEGMENT_DELETE_V1
at hunk granularity. Classify with RELATIVE_POLARITY_EPS_V1 on the set of those deltas
(or per-commit hunk delta set including all hunks if needed for M).
Report fraction of the top-2 whose class is NEGATIVE (occlusion delta < -eps),
i.e. attention-highlighted hunks that suppress buggy evidence under occlusion.
rq3_attention_top2_hunks.name: ATTENTION_TOP2_HUNK_OCCLUSION_SIGN_V1

diff_polarity_swap.definition:
Invert diff polarity by swapping ADD↔DEL semantic roles in the structured
representation (change_type / markers), re-render/re-tokenize under the same
prompt contract, and recompute attributions. Compare attribution mass /
rankings under swap vs original. Prediction change is recorded but the probe
asks whether attributions flip with polarity even when risk score is stable.
diff_polarity_swap.name: DIFF_POLARITY_SWAP_V1

test_file_category.note:
No audited test-path heuristic is frozen. Do not classify by '/test/' alone.
Until an audited rule is accepted, test-file mass summaries remain UNKNOWN /
PENDING and must not be reported as scientific TEST vs PRODUCTION splits.
